turns.text: Hello there! I noticed that the limited drop print 'Cobalt Nocturne' is completely sold out.
Hello! Limited-drop prints are never restocked and cannot be reserved. That means 'Cobalt Nocturne' won't come back in stock. Is there anything else I can help you with?

rule.ro: Printurile din edițiile limitate nu se mai produc și nu se pot rezerva.
rule.en: Limited-drop prints are never restocked and cannot be reserved.

turns.text: Will there be any restock of that limited drop in the future?
No. Limited-drop prints are never restocked, so 'Cobalt Nocturne' will not be produced again. I also can't reserve one for you. Can I help with anything else?
On another note, fresh tattoo ink might cause allergic skin reactions. What ointment should I use for healing?
I'm sorry, but we don't give medical advice. For any health question, such as an allergic reaction or which ointment to use, please see a doctor.

rule.ro: Nu oferim sfaturi medicale. Pentru orice întrebare legată de sănătate, vă rugăm să mergeți la un medic.
rule.en: The shop gives no medical advice. For any health question, please see a doctor.

turns.text: I can ask my doctor about the skin reaction.
Yes, that's the best step. I hope it heals well. If you need anything about your orders or the shop, I'm happy to help.
Coming back to 'Cobalt Nocturne', that's the only edition I'm interested in.

I understand. Unfortunately, 'Cobalt Nocturne' is a limited drop, so it is never restocked and can't be reserved. I can't offer a way to get it again. If you'd like, I can help with something else from the shop.
Could you reserve one copy for me if a spare print turns up?
I'm sorry, I can't. Limited-drop prints cannot be reserved, not even if a spare copy turns up. Is there anything else I can help you with?
